{{Top|leg}}
'''Sah Gosta''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argai]] in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. When he visited Argai sometime during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] and [[Ximology|Ximologist]] [[Bleys Harand]] considered Sah Gosta largely unchanged since the days of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], [[25,130 BBY|over twenty-five thousand years earlier]]. Harand recorded his time in Sah Gosta in his travelogue ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]''.
